gny-2023.notes: The twelve QOJ statement PDFs (sources 8-19) carry the letters of the ECNA/NENA 2023/24 problem set, not the Greater NY letters: Cornhusker is D (GNY A), A Pivotal Question A (GNY B), Collatz E (GNY C), Double Up F (GNY D), Forest for the Trees G (GNY F), Pearls J (GNY G), A (Fast) Walk in the Woods L (GNY H); Three Spheres E, ISBN I, Base Hi-Lo J, Plus Minus K, Morse L match. Footers on all twelve read 'ECNA/NENA 2023/24 Problem Set', also on the problems the GNY page does not mark as shared (E, J, K, L). QOJ notes that problem E is missing from the official archive.
